text:
Ananya: Quick ask — legal wants proof of VPC/network isolation for a customer pre-Private-deploy sign-off. What artifacts do we hand over? e.g. netpol, packet captures, KMS access logs, RBAC diffs? timeline: EOD Tue?
Mike L: Short answer: combination of config + telemetry + active tests. Netpol + conntrack, audit logs from control plane, KMS decrypt events, and a small smoke test that simulates tenant cross-talk.
Sara P: For netpol include both YAML and 'kubectl get networkpolicies --all-namespaces -o yaml' export. Also include policy egress/ingress counters from calico/iptables.
Tom I: Add pcap/pcapng captures showing no flows between tenant subnets. We usually run tcpdump on node with filter 'not host <node-ip> and dst net <other-tenant-cidr>'
Ananya: Could you paste a minimal netpol snippet we can run? :pray: 
Mike L: 
```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: deny-cross-tenant
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
  - Ingress
  - Egress
  ingress: []
  egress:
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.0.0.0/8
        except:
        - 10.0.1.0/24 # tenant-a cidr
```
Sara P: Also note: RBAC change history (git pr + kube audit) showing serviceAccount creation/scopes. Export 'kubectl get clusterrolebindings -o yaml' and the PR diff.
Ananya: KMS side — legal asked for key access logs for the past 30 days. How do we show decrypt attempts tied to tenant keys?
Tom I: We have KMS audit events in our SIEM. Query: `kusto: SecurityEvents | where Resource == "kms" and Operation == "Decrypt" and ResourceId contains "tenant-a"` (example). Export CSV with timestamps + principal.
Mike L: Also export HSM/KMS ARNs and the KMS policy version. If customer wants proof of no key material leakage, include key metadata (no plaintext keys in logs).
Ananya: Any automated probes for isolation? I'll add to the evidence pack.
Sara P: We run an e2e test that attempts cross-tenant access via: 1) pod-to-pod curl to service on other namespace, 2) nodePort access from other-tenant node, 3) metadata service access using SSRF sim.
Mike L: Example commands:
```
# from tenant-a pod
curl -sS --connect-timeout 2 http://10.0.1.42:8080/health || echo FAIL
# tcpdump listen
sudo tcpdump -w cross_tenant.pcap 'host 10.0.1.42'
```
Tom I: For vulnerability triage: include CVE list for agent versions, image digests, and fix backlog. If there's a vuln in our network agent, show patched nodes + rollout PR.
Ananya: Incident response evidence — customer asked "what would've happened if someone attempted lateral move?" Any runbook proof?
Mike L: Link to playbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/priv-deploy/lateral-move.md. Attach run logs from simulated drill (date, attack vector, actions taken). Add timeline + pager messages redacted.
Sara P: Also add firewall conntrack tables showing drops. `conntrack -L | grep DROP` and iptables counters for the netpol chains.
Ananya: Great. I'll assemble artifacts: netpol YAML, k8s export, pcaps, KMS decrypt CSV, RBAC PRs, vuln matrix, runbook drill logs. Anyone want to add automations to generate this pack?
Tom I: We have a script under infra/tools/isolation-audit/generate_pack.sh — can hook it to run with args: tenant and window.
Mike L: I'll add a small wrapper to redact sensitive fields and sign the bundle with our code-sign key.
Ananya: Thanks :thumbsup: Please drop links to PRs/files here when ready. Need to send to legal by EOD Tue.
deploy-bot: Build #6421 passed for infra/tools/isolation-audit (artifact: isolation-pack-2024-11-02.tar.gz)
Sara P: Uploaded initial pack to S3: s3://redwood-priv-evidence/tenant-a/pack-2024-11-02.tar.gz :eyes: 
Ananya: Perfect. Will review and then forward. Anyone who wants to run extra probes ping me.
